confirmatory.downstream_optimization_endpoint: relative best-objective improvement of learned versus restart; positive means lower minimization cost
confirmatory.inference: Independent case is the unit. Paired mean effects use deterministic 10000-resample case bootstrap intervals. Rank tests, if reported, are secondary. A null objective result is retained as a valid downstream boundary and does not trigger further experiment selection.
confirmatory.primary_family_adjustment: If formal rank tests are reported for the three P10 primary contrasts (learned-minus-empirical reused prior nodes, empirical-minus-learned new nodes, and restart-minus-learned wall-clock time), use one-sided Wilcoxon tests in the prespecified positive direction and Holm-adjust across the three-primary-endpoint family. Bootstrap confidence intervals remain estimation intervals.
confirmatory.primary_mechanistic_endpoint: paired learned-minus-empirical cumulative prior exact-search nodes represented by checkpoints at legal compatible resumes per case; this is a resume-weighted mechanistic quantity, while actual new work avoided is the separate operational endpoint
confirmatory.primary_operational_endpoint: paired empirical-minus-learned newly executed exact-search nodes per case (positive means learned executes fewer new nodes)
confirmatory.primary_wall_clock_endpoint: paired restart-minus-learned median end-to-end milliseconds per case over three deterministic repeats (positive means learned is faster than restart and therefore has net wall-clock benefit)
confirmatory.sample_size_rationale: 45 independent confirmatory cases fixed before outcomes, matching the scale of the prior confirmatory block and supporting paired case-level estimation. No sequential or outcome-dependent sample-size expansion is permitted.
secondary_endpoints: empirical-compatible-minus-learned median end-to-end milliseconds (incremental learned timing effect)
learned-minus-empirical checkpoint byte-time and peak checkpoint bytes
confirmatory.timing_design: One non-authoritative warm-up precedes authoritative timing. Policy execution is counterbalanced with a frozen 4x4 Latin-square order across seed and repeat; three repeats are interleaved rather than run policy-by-policy. Controller runtime excludes one-time model loading, instance generation, and trace construction.
confirmatory.timing_execution: Sequential; do not use multiprocessing for authoritative wall-clock comparisons.

engineering_certificate_backend: SciPy/HiGHS MILP used only to verify exact MDKP repairs on engineering cases; P10 checkpoint repair itself is the custom serializable B&B.
exact_allocation_backend: P10-local exact instantaneous 0/1 byte-allocation implementation in independent_mdkp/allocation.py; sparse DP for <=12 candidates and zero-requested-gap SciPy/HiGHS MILP for wider pools; identical allocator for learned and empirical-compatible policies.
exact_repair_backend: independent serializable depth-first branch-and-bound implemented in 04_CODE/independent_mdkp

execution_environment.environment_capture: P10_ENVIRONMENT.json is written before confirmatory execution.

prediction.holdout_inference: Report prevalence/history-only/learned predictive metrics with 2000 case-bootstrap 95% intervals; learned calibration intercept/slope also use case bootstrap.
prediction.model: fixed logistic regression, C=10, P10 H+D analogue features, five case-grouped folds, Platt calibration from out-of-fold logits
prediction.model_selection: No target-domain model-family search: the model family and calibration rule are fixed by protocol.

scientific_purpose: Independent-domain validation of predictive finite-memory persistence with a separately implemented exact-search backend and live end-to-end timing.

screen.execution_order: For each screen seed, candidate cells are rotated/interleaved; one non-authoritative warm-up run precedes screen timing.
screen.primary_memory_budget_rule: max(median largest checkpoint bytes, round(0.25 * median keep-all peak bytes)) from the selected outcome-blind screen cell; this fixed byte capacity is then used for every confirmatory case.
screen.selection_rule: Among eligible cells choose lexicographically largest (median repair-search milliseconds per decision, median fraction of iterations with >=4 live checkpoints, median peak live checkpoints). No learned-policy, work-saving, wall-clock-policy, or objective outcome enters selection.

stop_rule: After P10 confirmatory execution and prespecified analysis, do not add another experiment solely because a primary or downstream effect is null. Additional work is justified only by an engineering invalidity discovered before or during execution.
